comments.author: vmoens
comments.body:
Hello
Torchrl is built against a specific version of PyTorch -- 2.10 for Torchrl 0.11
You can build it locally by doing `pip install git+https://github.com/pytorch/rl.git@v0.11.1` IIRC
Also, you can ignore this if you don't need prioritised replay buffers!

comments.body:
